details.text:
[assistant] 1. High: official Codex skills only resolve if the on-disk folder name already matches `safe_id(skill_id)`. [core/external_skill_sources.py:254](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L254) turns any directory name into a normalized `skill_id`, but [core/utils.py:270](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/utils.py#L270) later looks up the local file only at `<root>/<safe_id(skill_id)>/{SKILL.md,skill.md}`. A folder like `review-guide/` will be exposed as `review_guide` by the source scanner, but [core/agent_runner.py:349](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/agent_runner.py#L349) and [agent_launcher.py:108](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/agent_launcher.py#L108) will never find it locally because they probe `review_guide/`, not the real `review-guide/`. That means a class of valid official skills will be treated as missing unless they are first copied into the local `skills/` tree.

2. High: the fallback importer now silently drops legacy nested single-file repo layouts that used to be discoverable. In [core/external_skill_candidate_importer.py:224](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_candidate_importer.py#L224)-[229](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_candidate_importer.py#L229), `scan_python=True` only accepts `skill.py` or a `.py` file at the repo root. Anything like `repo_alpha/issue_tracker.py` or `skills/foo.py` is skipped, even though the existing codebase still recognizes that legacy shape in registry data, e.g. [tests/test_registry.py:58](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/tests/test_registry.py#L58). Because [core/external_skill_candidate_importer.py:324](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_candidate_importer.py#L324) only falls back to this scanner when there is no manifest, those repos will now appear empty and never become install candidates.

3. Medium: research-driven candidate reuse still treats only Python skills as “verified”, so markdown/official Codex skills can be found but not reused through the top-candidate path. [core/researcher.py:76](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/researcher.py#L76)-[95](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/researcher.py#L95) computes verification exclusively from `resolve_skill_paths()` and `exists_skill_py`, which stays false for `SKILL.md`-only skills. Then [core/skill_procurer.py:449](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/skill_procurer.py#L449)-[452](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/skill_procurer.py#L452) requires both `candidate_path` and `evidence["verified"]`, so a local official knowledge skill suggested by research will still fall through to external install/build instead of being reused.

대상은 현재 diff 기준으로 리뷰했습니다. 타깃 테스트는 통과했지만, 전체 스위트는 다시 돌리지 않았고 `tests/test_knowledge_skill.py`는 이 샌드박스의 temp 권한 문제로 신뢰성 있게 검증하지 못했습니다.
